generation.explanation: The matrix sends each point (x, y) to (2x + y, y): it doubles the horizontal component and adds a horizontal shear, while leaving height unchanged. Its determinant is 2, so every region becomes twice as large in area; the positive sign means orientation is preserved. Drag either corner to compare a rectangle with its transformed parallelogram—the area ratio stays 2.
